text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm walking around school one day,
when...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ding dong, ding dong!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Next!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That's me! Number 7, Kitasan Black!
Smiles or
sorrow, I can sing it all. For my
song, I've chosen...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, we still have more people wanting
to
audition?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Very well. Umamusume or human, these
song
samples will help me analyze
empathic
understanding all the same.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
We'll hear what your voice has to offer
after her,
then!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Please, back of the line. It's her turn.

Number 7, you may begin.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Okay, here I go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, I've gotten roped into singing
for
science.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Number 18, take the stage, please.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At last, I'm dragged out in front of the
mic. I
guess I just have to give it my best
shot...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I dig up a lullaby from old memories and
sing
along as best as I can remember.
choice_data_list: ゆりかごのように……子守唄を
激しく情熱を燃やして！盛大に歌う！

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: A lullaby? Really now?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, this melody sure takes me back.
But who's
the one singing?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yawn... What a nice song... I'm getting sleepy...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Uh-huh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The sun's warm rays, along with my
singing, bring
a sleepy end to the
audition.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Well... maybe this could be one way to
help
<chrname> relax.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I get into the groove and belt out a
melody,
shaking my head up and down
to the beat!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Wh-whoa! I can feel the passion!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh? And this passion... what kind of
feeling is it,
exactly?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hearing all this shouting and screaming,
it's like...
like a fire's been lit in my soul!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: YEAHHH!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Excellent! Bravo!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: They're multiplying...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Next thing I know, the stage is swarming
with
students.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Come on, everybody! Let's get fired up!

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text:
Woohoo! Sing from the soul! Passion!
Passion!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Could this be some sort of resonance

phenomenon? No...

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Passion! Passion! Passion! Passion!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...No, that's not it. What in the name of
science is
this?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I now have a deeper understanding of
what
passion truly is. I should relate my
findings to
<chrname>.
